source.text: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְשָׁלֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן־אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יְהוֹאָחָ֨ז בֶּן־יֵה֤וּא עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן שְׁבַ֥ע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In year twenty and three year of Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah reigned Jehoahaz son of Jehu over Israel in Samaria seven-teen year[s].

en.L: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria seventeen years.
en.B: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned seventeen years.
en.R: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king over Israel in the twenty-third year that Joash son of Ahaziah was king of Judah. He ruled from Samaria for seventeen years.

es.L: En el año veintitrés de Joás hijo de Ocozías, rey de Judá, reinó Joacaz hijo de Jehú sobre Israel en Samaria diecisiete años.
es.B: En el año veintitrés de Joás hijo de Ocozías, rey de Judá, Joacaz hijo de Jehú comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Samaria, y reinó diecisiete años.
es.R: Joacaz hijo de Jehú comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en el año veintitrés del reinado de Joás hijo de Ocozías en Judá. Gobernó desde Samaria durante diecisiete años.

fr.L: En la vingt-troisième année de Joas fils d’Achazia, roi de Juda, Joachaz fils de Jéhu régna sur Israël à Samarie dix-sept ans.
fr.B: La vingt-troisième année du règne de Joas, fils d’Achazia, roi de Juda, Joachaz, fils de Jéhu, devint roi d’Israël à Samarie ; il régna dix-sept ans.
fr.R: Joachaz fils de Jéhu est devenu roi d’Israël la vingt-troisième année du règne de Joas fils d’Achazia, roi de Juda. Il a régné à Samarie pendant dix-sept ans.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na tatu wa Yoashi mwana wa Ahazia mfalme wa Yuda, Yehoahazi mwana wa Yehu alitawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria miaka kumi na saba.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na tatu wa Yoashi mwana wa Ahazia mfalme wa Yuda, Yehoahazi mwana wa Yehu alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria, akatawala miaka kumi na saba.
sw.R: Yehoahazi mwana wa Yehu alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli katika mwaka wa ishirini na tatu wa utawala wa Yoashi mwana wa Ahazia mfalme wa Yuda. Alitawala akiwa Samaria kwa miaka kumi na saba.

vi.L: Năm thứ hai mươi ba đời Giô-ách con trai A-cha-xia vua Giu-đa, Giô-a-cha con trai Giê-hu trị vì trên Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri mười bảy năm.
vi.B: Năm thứ hai mươi ba đời Giô-ách con trai A-cha-xia vua Giu-đa, Giô-a-cha con trai Giê-hu lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri và trị vì mười bảy năm.
vi.R: Giô-a-cha con trai Giê-hu lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên vào năm thứ hai mươi ba đời Giô-ách con trai A-cha-xia làm vua Giu-đa. Ông cai trị tại Sa-ma-ri mười bảy năm.

ko.L: 유다 왕 아하시야의 아들 요아스의 제이십삼년에 예후의 아들 여호아하스가 사마리아에서 이스라엘을 십칠 년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 유다 왕 아하시야의 아들 요아스가 다스린 지 이십삼 년째 되는 해에 예후의 아들 여호아하스가 사마리아에서 이스라엘의 왕이 되어 십칠 년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 유다 왕 아하시야의 아들 요아스가 다스린 지 이십삼 년째 되는 해에 예후의 아들 여호아하스가 이스라엘의 왕이 되었다. 그는 사마리아에서 십칠 년 동안 다스렸다.

decisions.choice: reigned ... seventeen years: became king and reigned seventeen years
decisions.reason: One verb does both jobs, as in the accession formula elsewhere in Kings (1 Kings 15:33): it dates the start of the reign and, with the number, gives its length.

decisions.choice: Jehoahaz son of Jehu: the second king of Jehu's dynasty
decisions.reason: Jehu had wiped out the house of Ahab and taken the throne (9:1-10:28); Jehoahaz followed him when he died (10:35). Yahweh had promised Jehu that his sons would sit on Israel's throne to the fourth generation (10:30).

decisions.choice: Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah: the boy king saved from Athaliah
decisions.reason: This Joash was hidden as a baby and made king of Judah at seven (11:1-12:1). At this time Israel's king Jehoahaz also has a son named Joash (verse 9), so two kings of the same name reign side by side for a time.

decisions.choice: and he reigned
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the verb twice, "became king" and "reigned", as the accession formula does at this level throughout Kings. Readable splits it into two sentences.

decisions.choice: "reinó ... diecisiete años" (L); "comenzó a reinar ..., y reinó diecisiete años" (B); "comenzó a reinar ... Gobernó ... durante" (R)
decisions.reason: The accession formula keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets: Literal keeps the single verb of the Hebrew, Balanced gives "comenzó a reinar" and "reinó", Readable splits the sentence as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Joacaz", "Joás", "Ocozías", "Jehú"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish forms, as the terms note's table gives them. Spanish writes "Joás" both for the short form Joash and the long form Jehoash, so the two kings named Joás (of Judah and of Israel) are told apart by their fathers and kingdoms, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: the accession formula: "régna sur Israël à Samarie N ans" (L); "devint roi d'Israël à Samarie ; il régna N ans" (B); "est devenu roi ... il a régné" (R)
decisions.reason: For 2 Kings 13-25, the regnal formulas keep one wording per level, as the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets. Narration is in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced and in the passé composé at Readable, as French narrative prose and the French style guide have it.

decisions.choice: Joachaz; Joas; Achazia
decisions.reason: The French forms of the terms note for these kings. Joas king of Judah and Joas (Yehoash) king of Israel keep the form each verse uses, as the English does.

decisions.choice: The accession formula in its fixed wording: "alitawala ... miaka N" (Literal); "alianza kutawala ..., akatawala miaka N" (Balanced); "alianza kutawala ... Alitawala ... kwa miaka N" (Readable)
decisions.reason: One wording per level for the accession of a king of Israel through Kings and Chronicles, as the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets it. Literal keeps the one Hebrew verb; Balanced gives it twice, as the English does.

decisions.choice: trị vì (L); lên làm vua ... và trị vì (B); lên làm vua ... cai trị (R)
decisions.reason: The accession formula has one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets it: Literal keeps the single verb "trị vì" with the length of the reign; Balanced says "lên làm vua ... và trị vì N năm"; Readable splits it and uses the everyday "cai trị". Names follow the terms note: Giô-a-cha (Jehoahaz), Giô-ách (Joash), A-cha-xia, Giê-hu.

decisions.choice: The accession formula for Israel: "유다 왕 X의 제N년에 ... 다스렸다" (L); "유다 왕 X가 다스린 지 N년째 되는 해에 Z의 아들 Y가 사마리아에서 이스라엘의 왕이 되어 N년 동안 다스렸다" (B); R splits it into two sentences
decisions.reason: The wording fixed in the Kings and Chronicles terms note, kept the same for every king of Israel in this block. The years are written in Korean number words, as short numbers are in running text.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ֠יֵּלֶךְ אַחַ֨ר חַטֹּ֜את יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹא־סָ֥ר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh and walked after [the] sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat which he made sin Israel; not he turned aside from it.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and he walked after the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he made Israel sin; he did not turn aside from it.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and followed the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, by which he led Israel to sin; he did not turn away from them.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil. He kept on in the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, the sins by which Jeroboam led Israel into sin. He did not turn away from them.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y anduvo tras los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, con que hizo pecar a Israel; no se apartó de ello.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y siguió los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, que este hizo cometer a Israel; no se apartó de ellos.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba. Siguió en los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, los pecados con que Jeroboam hizo pecar a Israel. No se apartó de ellos.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il marcha à la suite des péchés de Jéroboam fils de Nebath, qu’il avait fait commettre à Israël ; il ne s’en détourna pas.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et il suivit les péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qu’il avait fait commettre à Israël ; il ne s’en détourna pas.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais. Il a continué dans les péchés de Jéroboam fils de Nebath, ces péchés que Jéroboam avait fait commettre à Israël. Il ne s’en est pas détourné.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaenda kufuata dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, alizowafanya Israeli kutenda; hakugeuka kuiacha.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akafuata dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, alizowafanya Israeli kutenda; hakuziacha.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya. Aliendelea katika dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, dhambi ambazo Yeroboamu aliwaongoza Israeli kuzitenda. Hakuziacha.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và đi theo các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, là tội mà ông ấy đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm; ông không lìa bỏ tội ấy.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đi theo các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, là tội mà ông ấy đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm; ông không từ bỏ các tội ấy.
vi.R: Ông làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác. Ông cứ theo các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, là những tội mà Giê-rô-bô-am đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm. Ông không từ bỏ các tội đó.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했고, 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 그 죄들을 따라 걸었다. 그는 그것에서 떠나지 않았다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다. 그는 느밧의 아들 여로보암의 길로 걸으며 그가 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄를 따랐고, 그 죄에서 떠나지 않았다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그는 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄를 계속 따랐다. 그는 그 죄에서 떠나지 않았다.

decisions.choice: the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat: the worship at the golden calves of Bethel and Dan
decisions.reason: Jeroboam set up the calves so that Israel would not go to Jerusalem to worship (1 Kings 12:26-33). Jehu destroyed Baal worship but kept these shrines (10:29, 31), and his son does the same. Kings judges every king of Israel by this sin.

decisions.choice: made Israel sin: caused the nation to sin
decisions.reason: The verb is causative: Jeroboam led the whole people into sin, and each later king who kept his shrines shared in it (1 Kings 16:2).

decisions.choice: from it: from that sin as a whole
decisions.reason: The pronoun is singular though "sins" is plural. It gathers Jeroboam's sins together as one way of worship.

decisions.choice: the verdict and the sin of Jeroboam in their fixed wording
decisions.reason: The verdict formula keeps one wording at each level through Kings: "did the evil in [the] eyes of" (Literal), "did what was evil in the sight of" (Balanced), "did what the LORD said was evil" (Readable). The formula of the sin of Jeroboam keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as at 3:3: "made Israel sin" (Literal), "led Israel to sin" (Balanced), "led Israel into sin" (Readable).

decisions.choice: followed / kept on in; from them
decisions.reason: "Walked after" means followed as a way of life. Balanced and Readable say "them" for the singular "it", since English speaks of the sins in the plural (m3).

decisions.choice: "hizo lo malo a los ojos del SEÑOR" (L, B); "hizo lo que el SEÑOR reprueba" (R); "con que hizo pecar a Israel" (L); "que este hizo cometer a Israel" (B)
alternatives: hizo lo que desagrada al SEÑOR
decisions.reason: The verdict and the sin of Jeroboam keep one wording at each level through Kings, as the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets them.

decisions.choice: "de ello" (L); "de ellos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular of the Hebrew with the neuter "ello"; Balanced and Readable say "ellos" for the sins, as the English says "them" (m3).

decisions.choice: the verdict: "fit ce qui est mal aux yeux du SEIGNEUR" (L, B), "a fait ce que le SEIGNEUR déclare mauvais" (R); the sin of Jeroboam: "qu'il avait fait commettre à Israël"
decisions.reason: The fixed French wording of the verdict and of the sin of Jeroboam through Kings, as the terms note sets. French "s'en" covers the singular "it" of the Hebrew without choosing a number, so no plural is needed (m3).

decisions.choice: The verdict and the sin of Jeroboam in their fixed wording: "alifanya maovu machoni pa BWANA" (Literal, Balanced), "alifanya yale BWANA aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya" (Readable); "dhambi ... alizowafanya Israeli kutenda" (Literal, Balanced), "aliwaongoza Israeli kuzitenda" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms note gives one wording per level for the verdict and the sin formula, used for every king.

decisions.choice: hakugeuka kuiacha (singular "it")
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular pronoun of the Hebrew with "-i-" agreeing with "dhambi" as one (meaning decision m3); Balanced and Readable use the plural "-zi-".

decisions.choice: làm điều ác trước mắt CHÚA (L); trước mặt CHÚA (B); làm điều CHÚA cho là ác (R); tội mà ông đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm
decisions.reason: The verdict and the sin of Jeroboam keep the wording of the terms note at each level through Kings. Literal keeps the Hebrew "eyes" (trước mắt); Balanced says the natural "trước mặt"; Readable says what the LORD judged evil.

decisions.choice: các tội ấy (B, R) for the singular "it"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular, "tội ấy"; Balanced and Readable speak of the sins in the plural, as the English does (m3).

decisions.choice: The verdict "주의 눈에 악한 일을 했다" (L), "보시기에 악한 일을 했다" (B), "께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다" (R); the sin of Jeroboam "여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄"
decisions.reason: The fixed formulas of the terms note, one wording per level through Kings. The causative "짓게 한" keeps that Jeroboam led the nation into sin.

decisions.choice: "그 죄에서" for the singular "from it"
decisions.reason: Korean need not mark the plural, so "그 죄" gathers Jeroboam's sins as one way of worship, as the Hebrew singular does; Literal keeps "그것".

source.text: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֞ם בְּיַ֣ד׀חֲזָאֵ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ־אֲרָ֗ם וּבְיַ֛ד בֶּן־הֲדַ֥ד בֶּן־חֲזָאֵ֖ל כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And burned [the] anger of Yahweh against Israel, and he gave them into [the] hand of Hazael king of Aram and into [the] hand of Ben-hadad son of Hazael all the days.

en.L: And the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned against Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them into [the] hand of Hazael king of Aram and into [the] hand of Ben-hadad son of Hazael all the days.
en.B: So the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned against Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them into the power of Hazael king of Aram and of Ben-hadad son of Hazael throughout that time.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} became angry with Israel. He handed them over to Hazael king of Aram and to his son Ben-hadad for all those years.

es.L: Y se encendió la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} contra Israel, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los entregó en mano de Hazael, rey de Aram, y en mano de Ben-adad hijo de Hazael, todos los días.
es.B: Así que la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se encendió contra Israel, y los entregó en poder de Hazael, rey de Aram, y de Ben-adad hijo de Hazael, durante todo aquel tiempo.
es.R: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó con Israel. Los dejó caer en manos de Hazael, rey de Aram, y de su hijo Ben-adad durante todos esos años.

fr.L: Et la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les livra dans la main de Hazaël, roi d’Aram, et dans la main de Ben-Hadad fils de Hazaël, tous les jours.
fr.B: Alors la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les livra au pouvoir de Hazaël, roi d’Aram, et de Ben-Hadad, fils de Hazaël, pendant toute cette période.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis en colère contre Israël. Il a livré les Israélites à Hazaël, roi d’Aram, et à son fils Ben-Hadad, pendant toutes ces années.

sw.L: Na hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka juu ya Israeli, akawatia katika mkono wa Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu na katika mkono wa Ben-hadadi mwana wa Hazaeli siku zote.
sw.B: Basi hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka juu ya Israeli, akawatia katika nguvu za Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu na za Ben-hadadi mwana wa Hazaeli wakati huo wote.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwakasirikia Israeli. Akawatia mikononi mwa Hazaeli mfalme wa Aramu na mwanawe Ben-hadadi kwa miaka hiyo yote.

vi.L: Cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi phừng lên cùng Y-sơ-ra-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phó họ vào tay Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram và vào tay Bên-Ha-đát con trai Ha-xa-ên suốt các ngày [ấy].
vi.B: Vì thế, cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi lên cùng Y-sơ-ra-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phó họ vào quyền lực của Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram và của Bên-Ha-đát con trai Ha-xa-ên suốt thời gian đó.
vi.R: Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi giận với Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ngài trao họ vào tay Ha-xa-ên vua A-ram và Bên-Ha-đát con trai ông suốt những năm ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 이스라엘에게 불타올라, 그분께서 그들을 아람 왕 하사엘의 손과 하사엘의 아들 벤하닷의 손에 그 모든 날 동안 넘기셨다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 이스라엘에게 불타올랐다. 그분께서는 그 기간 내내 그들을 아람 왕 하사엘과 하사엘의 아들 벤하닷의 손에 넘기셨다.
ko.R: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에게 크게 노하셨다. 그분께서는 그 여러 해 동안 이스라엘을 아람 왕 하사엘과 그의 아들 벤하닷에게 넘기셨다.

decisions.choice: the anger of Yahweh burned: Yahweh became angry
decisions.reason: Anger is pictured as a fire that flares up, as in Judges 2:14, 20. The cause is the sin of verse 2.

decisions.choice: gave them into the hand of: put them under the power of
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power and control, the language of Judges (Judges 2:14; 6:1). Yahweh lets Aram overpower Israel.

decisions.choice: Hazael and his son Ben-hadad: kings of Aram, ruling from Damascus
decisions.reason: Elisha had wept when he foresaw the harm Hazael would do to Israel (8:11-13), and Hazael had already taken all Israel's land east of the Jordan in Jehu's day (10:32-33). His son bore a name used by earlier kings of Aram (1 Kings 15:18; 20:1).

decisions.choice: all the days: continually, through that period
decisions.reason: The phrase means the pressure did not let up. Verse 22 says Hazael oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz, and the cities were not won back until Ben-hadad's time (verse 25).

decisions.choice: gave them into the power of (Balanced); handed them over to (Readable); throughout that time / for all those years
decisions.reason: As in Judges, Balanced turns "hand" into "power" and Readable says "handed them over". Readable calls Ben-hadad "his son" where the Hebrew says "son of Hazael".

decisions.choice: "en poder de" (B); "los dejó caer en manos de" (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced turns "hand" into "poder" and Readable says the Arameans got hold of them, following the English levels (m2).

decisions.choice: "livra au pouvoir de" (B); "a livré ... à" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced turns "hand" into power and Readable simply says "handed over"; Readable names "les Israélites" so that "les" is clear.

decisions.choice: katika nguvu za (Balanced); akawatia mikononi mwa (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced turns "hand" into "power", as the English does; Readable keeps the everyday Swahili idiom "kutia mikononi mwa", which means to hand over.

decisions.choice: quyền lực (B) for "hand"
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the sense of "hand", power, as the English does; Literal and Readable keep "tay", which Vietnamese uses for control in "trao vào tay".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans; "그분께서" and the honorific -시- carry respect for God
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (Korean style guide, section 7).

source.text: וַיְחַ֥ל יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֤י רָאָה֙ אֶת־לַ֣חַץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־לָחַ֥ץ אֹתָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ אֲרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And entreated Jehoahaz [the] face of Yahweh, and listened to him Yahweh, for he saw the oppression of Israel, that oppressed them [the] king of Aram.

en.L: And Jehoahaz entreated the face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} listened to him, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw the oppression of Israel, that the king of Aram oppressed them.
en.B: Then Jehoahaz pleaded with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for favor, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} listened to him, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saw how the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.
en.R: Then Jehoahaz begged {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} listened to him. He saw how harshly the king of Aram was treating Israel.

es.L: Y Joacaz suplicó ante el rostro {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo escuchó, porque vio la opresión de Israel, que el rey de Aram los oprimía.
es.B: Entonces Joacaz suplicó el favor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo escuchó, porque vio cómo el rey de Aram oprimía a Israel.
es.R: Entonces Joacaz le rogó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} que lo ayudara, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo escuchó. Vio con cuánta dureza trataba el rey de Aram a Israel.

fr.L: Et Joachaz implora la face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’écouta, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vit l’oppression d’Israël, [car] le roi d’Aram les opprimait.
fr.B: Alors Joachaz supplia {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de lui être favorable, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’écouta, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voyait comment le roi d’Aram opprimait Israël.
fr.R: Alors Joachaz a supplié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de l’aider, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a écouté. Il voyait combien le roi d’Aram maltraitait Israël.

sw.L: Naye Yehoahazi akauomba uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamsikiliza, kwa kuwa aliyaona mateso ya Israeli, jinsi mfalme wa Aramu alivyowaonea.
sw.B: Kisha Yehoahazi alimsihi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amhurumie, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamsikiliza, kwa sababu aliona jinsi mfalme wa Aramu alivyokuwa akiwaonea Israeli.
sw.R: Kisha Yehoahazi alimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamsikiliza. Aliona jinsi mfalme wa Aramu alivyokuwa akiwatesa Israeli vikali.

vi.L: Giô-a-cha nài xin trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe lời ông, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy cảnh áp bức Y-sơ-ra-ên, là vua A-ram đã áp bức họ.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Giô-a-cha nài xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban ơn, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe lời ông, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy vua A-ram đang áp bức Y-sơ-ra-ên thế nào.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Giô-a-cha cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe lời ông. Ngài thấy vua A-ram đối xử tàn nhẫn với Y-sơ-ra-ên thế nào.

ko.L: 그리고 여호아하스가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 얼굴을 달래며 간구했고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 말을 들으셨다. 이는 그분께서 이스라엘이 당하는 압제, 곧 아람 왕이 그들을 압제하는 것을 보셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그때 여호아하스가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 은총을 간절히 구하자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 간구를 들으셨다. 아람 왕이 이스라엘을 얼마나 억누르고 있는지 보셨기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러자 여호아하스가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도와 달라고 애원했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 기도를 들으셨다. 아람 왕이 이스라엘을 얼마나 괴롭히고 있는지 보셨기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: entreated the face of Yahweh: pleaded with Yahweh for his favor
decisions.reason: The phrase pictures softening someone's face, that is, seeking to turn his anger into kindness. Moses prays in the same words in Exodus 32:11, and a king of Israel asks a prophet to do so in 1 Kings 13:6.

decisions.choice: he saw the oppression of Israel: the pattern of the exodus and of Judges
decisions.reason: The words echo Yahweh seeing the oppression of Israel in Egypt (Exodus 3:9) and having pity on them because of those who oppressed them in the days of the judges (Judges 2:18). A king who does evil still finds that Yahweh answers his people's distress.

decisions.choice: pleaded with ... for favor / begged ... for help; oppressing / treating harshly
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the sense of the idiom, "for favor"; Readable says what Jehoahaz asked for. Readable uses "treating harshly" for "oppress", here and in verse 22.

decisions.choice: "suplicó ante el rostro" (L); "suplicó el favor" (B); "le rogó ... que lo ayudara" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the face of the idiom; Balanced keeps its sense, favour; Readable says what Jehoahaz asked for, as the English levels do (m1).

decisions.choice: "supplia ... de lui être favorable" (B); "a supplié ... de l'aider" (R); "maltraitait" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the face; Balanced gives its sense, favor; Readable says what Jehoahaz asked for and uses "maltraiter" for "oppress", here and in verse 22.

decisions.choice: alimsihi ... amhurumie (Balanced); alimwomba ... awasaidie (Readable)
decisions.reason: Swahili does not speak of softening someone's face; Balanced keeps the sense, a plea for favor, and Readable says what he asked for, as the English does.

decisions.choice: nài xin trước mặt (L); nài xin ... ban ơn (B); cầu xin ... giúp đỡ (R)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese cannot keep "soften the face" without sounding odd; Literal keeps "trước mặt" (before the face), Balanced says he asked for favor, Readable for help.

decisions.choice: "얼굴을 달래며 간구했다"
decisions.reason: The idiom pictures softening someone's face; Literal keeps the face and says what is done to it, while Balanced and Readable say what he asked for.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וַיֵּ֣צְא֔וּ מִתַּ֖חַת יַד־אֲרָ֑ם וַיֵּשְׁב֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶ֖ם כִּתְמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And gave Yahweh to Israel a deliverer, and they went out from under [the] hand of Aram, and dwelt [the] sons of Israel in their tents as yesterday [and] three days ago.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Israel a deliverer, and they went out from under the hand of Aram, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel dwelt in their tents as yesterday [and] the day before.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave Israel a deliverer, and they escaped from the power of Aram. So the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} lived in their homes as they had before.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave Israel someone to rescue them, and they were set free from Aram's control. Then the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} lived in their own homes again, as they had in earlier times.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dio a Israel un libertador, y salieron de debajo de la mano de Aram; y los hijos de Israel habitaron en sus tiendas como ayer [y] anteayer.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Israel un libertador, y escaparon del poder de Aram. Así los israelitas vivieron en sus casas como antes.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Israel a alguien que los rescatara, y quedaron libres del dominio de Aram. Entonces los israelitas volvieron a vivir tranquilos en sus casas, como en tiempos pasados.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donna à Israël un libérateur, et ils sortirent de dessous la main d’Aram, et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël habitèrent dans leurs tentes comme hier [et] avant-hier.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donna à Israël un libérateur, et ils échappèrent au pouvoir d’Aram. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} habitèrent dans leurs maisons comme auparavant.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donné à Israël quelqu’un pour le délivrer, et les Israélites ont été libérés de la domination d’Aram. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont de nouveau vécu chez eux, comme autrefois.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawapa Israeli mwokozi, nao wakatoka chini ya mkono wa Aramu, na wana wa Israeli wakakaa katika hema zao kama jana [na] juzi.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa Israeli mwokozi, nao wakaokoka kutoka katika nguvu za Aramu. Basi Waisraeli wakaishi katika nyumba zao kama hapo awali.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa Israeli mtu wa kuwaokoa, nao wakawekwa huru kutoka katika utawala wa Aramu. Kisha Waisraeli wakaishi tena katika nyumba zao wenyewe, kama zamani.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Y-sơ-ra-ên một người giải cứu, và họ ra khỏi dưới tay A-ram; con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên ở trong các trại của mình như hôm qua [và] hôm kia.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Y-sơ-ra-ên một người giải cứu, và họ thoát khỏi quyền lực của A-ram. Vậy con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên được sống trong nhà mình như trước kia.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho Y-sơ-ra-ên một người đến cứu họ, và họ được giải thoát khỏi sự kiểm soát của A-ram. Rồi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lại được sống yên trong nhà mình như thời trước.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에게 구원자를 주셨고, 그들이 아람의 손 아래에서 벗어났다. 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 어제와 그제처럼 자기들의 장막에서 살았다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에게 구원자를 주셔서, 그들은 아람의 손에서 벗어났다. 그래서 이스라엘 자손은 전처럼 자기 집에서 살게 되었다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에게 그들을 구해 줄 사람을 주셨다. 그래서 그들은 아람의 지배에서 풀려났다. 이스라엘 사람들은 예전처럼 다시 자기 집에서 살게 되었다.

decisions.choice: a deliverer: one who rescues from enemies
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for the judges whom Yahweh raised up to rescue Israel (Judges 3:9, 15). Yahweh's answer to Jehoahaz follows the pattern of that book (verse 4).

decisions.choice: the deliverer is not named
alternatives: relief through Assyria's attacks on Aram
decisions.reason: The writer does not say who he was. He may be Jehoash, who won back Israel's cities (verse 25), or Jeroboam son of Jehoash, through whom Yahweh saved Israel (14:25-27). It is also possible that the relief came from outside: in these years the kings of Assyria pressed hard on Damascus, which drew Aram's strength away from Israel.

decisions.choice: dwelt in their tents: lived at home in peace
decisions.reason: "Tents" had come to mean homes in general, long after Israel lived in tents (1 Kings 8:66; 12:16). The people no longer had to flee or hide from raiders.

decisions.choice: as yesterday and the day before: as in former times
decisions.reason: The phrase means "as before" (Genesis 31:2; Exodus 5:7).

decisions.choice: deliverer / someone to rescue them; homes
decisions.reason: Readable follows Judges 3:9 in saying what a deliverer is. Balanced and Readable say "homes" for "tents" (m3); Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B, R); "tiendas" (L); "casas" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms note sets, "hijos" already takes in daughters, so Spanish needs no gender setting here. Balanced and Readable say "casas" for "tents", which had come to mean homes (m3).

decisions.choice: "un libérateur" (L, B); "quelqu'un pour le délivrer" (R); "tentes" (L), "maisons", "chez eux" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Libérateur" keeps the sense of the judges' title (m1) without the Christian weight of "sauveur"; Balanced and Readable say homes for "tents" (m3), as the English does.

decisions.choice: nyumba zao; kama hapo awali / kama zamani
alternatives: hema zao; kama jana na juzi
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "homes" for "tents" and give the sense of "yesterday and the day before"; Literal keeps both pictures, and "jana na juzi" is also a Swahili way of saying "lately".

decisions.choice: con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên (L, B); dân Y-sơ-ra-ên (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "con cháu" and "dân" already cover men and women, so the English gender span has no Vietnamese counterpart, as in Samuel.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" (L, B), "이스라엘 사람들" (R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: "자손" and "사람들" already include men and women, so Korean has no second wording to offer.

source.text: אַ֠ךְ לֹֽא־סָ֜רוּ מֵחַטֹּ֧אות בֵּית־יָרָבְעָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣הּ הָלָ֑ךְ וְגַם֙ הָאֲשֵׁרָ֔ה עָמְדָ֖ה בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: Only not they turned aside from [the] sins of [the] house of Jeroboam which he made sin Israel; in it he walked; and also the Asherah stood in Samaria.

en.L: Yet they did not turn aside from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, which he made Israel sin; in it he walked. And also the Asherah pole stood in Samaria.
en.B: Yet they did not turn away from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, by which he led Israel to sin, but kept walking in them. The Asherah pole also remained standing in Samaria.
en.R: But the people did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam's dynasty, the sins by which Jeroboam led Israel into sin. They kept on living in those sins. And the pole used to worship Asherah still stood in Samaria.

es.L: Sin embargo, no se apartaron de los pecados de la casa de Jeroboam, con que hizo pecar a Israel; en ello anduvo. Y también la Aserá permaneció en pie en Samaria.
es.B: Sin embargo, no se apartaron de los pecados de la casa de Jeroboam, que este hizo cometer a Israel, sino que siguieron andando en ellos. También el poste de Aserá siguió en pie en Samaria.
es.R: Pero el pueblo no se apartó de los pecados de la dinastía de Jeroboam, los pecados con que Jeroboam hizo pecar a Israel. Siguieron viviendo en esos pecados. Y el poste que usaban para adorar a Aserá todavía estaba en pie en Samaria.

fr.L: Cependant ils ne se détournèrent pas des péchés de la maison de Jéroboam, qu’il avait fait commettre à Israël ; il y marcha. Et même le poteau d’Ashéra resta debout à Samarie.
fr.B: Cependant ils ne se détournèrent pas des péchés de la maison de Jéroboam, qu’il avait fait commettre à Israël, mais ils continuèrent à y marcher. Le poteau d’Ashéra resta lui aussi debout à Samarie.
fr.R: Mais le peuple ne s’est pas détourné des péchés de la famille royale de Jéroboam, ces péchés que Jéroboam avait fait commettre à Israël. Les Israélites ont continué à vivre dans ces péchés. Et le poteau sacré de la déesse Ashéra était toujours debout à Samarie.

sw.L: Lakini hawakugeuka kuziacha dhambi za nyumba ya Yeroboamu, alizowafanya Israeli kutenda; aliendelea kwenda ndani yake. Tena mti wa Ashera ulisimama huko Samaria.
sw.B: Lakini hawakuziacha dhambi za nyumba ya Yeroboamu, alizowafanya Israeli kutenda, bali waliendelea kuenenda ndani yake. Mti wa Ashera nao ukaendelea kusimama huko Samaria.
sw.R: Lakini watu hawakuziacha dhambi za ukoo wa Yeroboamu, dhambi ambazo Yeroboamu aliwaongoza Israeli kuzitenda. Waliendelea kuishi katika dhambi hizo. Tena nguzo ya kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera ilikuwa bado imesimama huko Samaria.

vi.L: Nhưng họ không lìa bỏ các tội của nhà Giê-rô-bô-am, là tội mà ông ấy đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm; [Y-sơ-ra-ên] đi trong tội ấy. Cũng có trụ A-sê-ra đứng tại Sa-ma-ri.
vi.B: Nhưng họ không từ bỏ các tội của nhà Giê-rô-bô-am, là tội mà ông ấy đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm, mà cứ sống trong các tội ấy. Trụ A-sê-ra cũng vẫn còn đứng tại Sa-ma-ri.
vi.R: Nhưng dân chúng không từ bỏ các tội của dòng họ Giê-rô-bô-am, là những tội mà Giê-rô-bô-am đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm. Họ cứ sống trong các tội đó. Trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra vẫn còn đứng tại Sa-ma-ri.

ko.L: 그러나 그들은 여로보암의 집이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄들에서 떠나지 않았다. 그가 그것 안에서 걸었다. 그리고 아세라 목상도 사마리아에 서 있었다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들은 여로보암 집안이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄에서 떠나지 않고 그 죄 가운데서 계속 살았다. 아세라 목상도 사마리아에 그대로 서 있었다.
ko.R: 그러나 백성은 여로보암 왕가의 죄, 곧 여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄에서 떠나지 않았다. 그들은 계속 그 죄 가운데서 살았다. 또 아세라를 섬기는 데 쓰는 목상도 여전히 사마리아에 서 있었다.

decisions.choice: the house of Jeroboam: Jeroboam and the kings who kept his worship
decisions.reason: "House" here is a royal line. Jeroboam's own family was wiped out (1 Kings 15:29), but the sins he began were kept up by every king of Israel after him, so they are still called the sins of his house.

decisions.choice: in it he walked: Israel kept living in that sin
decisions.reason: The verb is singular, with Israel as one people as its likely subject; it could also be Jehoahaz. Either way the deliverance of verse 5 did not bring the nation back to Yahweh.

decisions.choice: the Asherah: the pole of the goddess Asherah that Ahab set up
decisions.reason: Ahab had made an Asherah pole in Samaria (1 Kings 16:33). Jehu destroyed the temple of Baal (10:26-28) but left this pole standing. The verb means it remained in place through these years.

decisions.choice: Asherah pole (Literal, Balanced); the pole used to worship Asherah (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for Asherah poles in Samuel and Kings (1 Kings 16:33).

decisions.choice: the sin formula; walking in them / living in those sins
decisions.reason: The formula of the sin of Jeroboam keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as at 3:3: "made Israel sin" (Literal), "led Israel to sin" (Balanced), "led Israel into sin" (Readable). Balanced and Readable say "them" for the singular "it", as in verse 2, and Readable names "the people" as the subject.

decisions.choice: "la Aserá" (L); "el poste de Aserá" (B); "el poste que usaban para adorar a Aserá" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "los postes de Aserá"; Readable explains it as the English does. Literal keeps the bare name of the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "le poteau d'Ashéra" (L, B); "le poteau sacré de la déesse Ashéra" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the Asherah pole; Readable says whose pole it was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: mti wa Ashera (Literal, Balanced); nguzo ya kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "miti ya Ashera" for Asherah poles and names the goddess at Readable.

decisions.choice: trụ A-sê-ra (L, B); trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "trụ A-sê-ra" for the Asherah pole; Readable says what the pole was for.

decisions.choice: "아세라 목상" (L, B); "아세라를 섬기는 데 쓰는 목상" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the Asherah pole; Readable says what it was for, as the English Readable does.

source.text: כִּ֣י לֹא֩ הִשְׁאִ֨יר לִיהוֹאָחָ֜ז עָ֗ם כִּ֣י אִם־חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים פָּֽרָשִׁים֙ וַעֲשָׂ֣רָה רֶ֔כֶב וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רַגְלִ֑י כִּ֤י אִבְּדָם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַיְשִׂמֵ֥ם כֶּֽעָפָ֖ר לָדֻֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: For not he left to Jehoahaz people except fifty horsemen and ten chariot[s] and ten thousand foot soldier[s], for destroyed them [the] king of Aram and made them like the dust for trampling.

en.L: For he did not leave to Jehoahaz [any] people except fifty horsemen and ten chariots and 10,000 foot soldiers, for the king of Aram had destroyed them and made them like the dust for trampling.
en.B: Jehoahaz had been left with no troops except fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and 10,000 foot soldiers, because the king of Aram had wiped them out and made them like dust to be trampled.
en.R: Jehoahaz had only fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and 10,000 foot soldiers left in his army. The king of Aram had destroyed the rest. He had crushed them like dust that is trampled underfoot.

es.L: Porque no le dejó a Joacaz [más] pueblo que cincuenta jinetes, diez carros y diez mil soldados de a pie, porque el rey de Aram los había destruido y los había dejado como el polvo de la trilla.
es.B: A Joacaz no le habían quedado más tropas que cincuenta jinetes, diez carros y diez mil soldados de a pie, porque el rey de Aram los había aniquilado y los había dejado como polvo pisoteado.
es.R: A Joacaz solo le quedaban en su ejército cincuenta jinetes, diez carros y diez mil soldados de a pie. El rey de Aram había destruido a los demás. Los había aplastado como el polvo que se pisa.

fr.L: Car il ne laissa à Joachaz [comme] peuple que cinquante cavaliers, dix chars et dix mille fantassins ; car le roi d’Aram les avait fait périr et les avait rendus comme la poussière qu’on foule.
fr.B: Il n’était resté à Joachaz pour toute armée que cinquante cavaliers, dix chars et dix mille fantassins, car le roi d’Aram les avait anéantis et rendus semblables à la poussière qu’on piétine.
fr.R: Il ne restait à Joachaz que cinquante cavaliers, dix chars et dix mille soldats à pied dans son armée. Le roi d’Aram avait détruit tout le reste. Il les avait écrasés comme de la poussière qu’on piétine.

sw.L: Kwa maana hakumwachia Yehoahazi watu ila wapanda farasi hamsini na magari ya vita kumi na askari wa miguu 10,000, kwa kuwa mfalme wa Aramu alikuwa amewaangamiza na kuwafanya kama mavumbi ya kupurwa.
sw.B: Yehoahazi alikuwa ameachiwa askari wapanda farasi hamsini tu, magari ya vita kumi na askari wa miguu 10,000, kwa sababu mfalme wa Aramu alikuwa amewaangamiza na kuwafanya kama mavumbi ya kukanyagwa.
sw.R: Yehoahazi alikuwa amebaki na wapanda farasi hamsini tu, magari ya vita kumi na askari wa miguu 10,000 katika jeshi lake. Mfalme wa Aramu alikuwa amewaangamiza wengine wote. Alikuwa amewaponda kama mavumbi yanayokanyagwa chini ya miguu.

vi.L: Vì [vua A-ram] không để lại cho Giô-a-cha [quân] dân nào, ngoại trừ năm mươi kỵ binh, mười xe chiến mã và mười nghìn bộ binh, vì vua A-ram đã tiêu diệt họ và làm cho họ như bụi để giày đạp.
vi.B: Giô-a-cha chỉ còn lại năm mươi kỵ binh, mười xe chiến mã và mười nghìn bộ binh, vì vua A-ram đã tiêu diệt quân lính của ông và làm cho họ như bụi bị giày đạp.
vi.R: Quân đội của Giô-a-cha chỉ còn năm mươi kỵ binh, mười xe chiến mã và mười nghìn bộ binh. Vua A-ram đã tiêu diệt số còn lại. Vua ấy nghiền nát họ như bụi bị chà đạp dưới chân.

ko.L: 이는 그가 여호아하스에게 기병 쉰 명과 병거 열 대와 보병 만 명 외에는 [어떤] 백성도 남겨 두지 않았기 때문이다. 아람 왕이 그들을 멸하여 타작할 때의 먼지처럼 만들었다.
ko.B: 여호아하스에게 남은 군대는 기병 쉰 명과 병거 열 대와 보병 만 명뿐이었다. 아람 왕이 그들을 쳐부수어 짓밟히는 먼지처럼 만들었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 여호아하스의 군대에는 기병 쉰 명, 병거 열 대, 보병 만 명만 남아 있었다. 아람 왕이 나머지를 다 쳐 없앴다. 그는 그들을 발에 밟히는 먼지처럼 짓밟아 버렸다.

decisions.choice: for: verse 7 explains the distress of verse 4
decisions.reason: Verses 5-6 are an aside that looks ahead to the rescue and back to Israel's sin. Verse 7 returns to the time of Jehoahaz's prayer and shows how weak Israel had become.

decisions.choice: he did not leave: the king of Aram left Jehoahaz this little
decisions.reason: The subject is not named at first; the end of the verse shows it is the king of Aram. Behind him stands Yahweh, who gave Israel into his power (verse 3).

decisions.choice: people: an army
decisions.reason: The word for "people" often means the fighting men of a nation. Fifty horsemen and ten chariots are next to nothing beside the two thousand chariots Ahab sent against Assyria a generation before, and beside the chariots David and Solomon had (1 Kings 10:26).

decisions.choice: like the dust for trampling: crushed as grain is threshed
decisions.reason: The verb is used of threshing grain by treading it. Amos says Hazael threshed Gilead with iron sledges (Amos 1:3), and Elisha had foretold that Hazael would crush Israel's fighting men (8:12).

decisions.choice: [any] people (Literal); troops (Balanced); army (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the word "people" when it means an army in the field. Balanced and Readable use a passive, "had been left", so that the subject is not mistaken for Yahweh (m2).

decisions.choice: destroyed the rest
decisions.reason: Readable says "the rest": the king of Aram destroyed the army apart from the few who remained.

decisions.choice: "pueblo" (L); "tropas" (B); "ejército" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for "the people" meaning an army: the ordinary word at Literal, troops or army at Balanced and Readable. Balanced uses an impersonal "no le habían quedado" so that Yahweh is not taken as the subject (m2).

decisions.choice: "peuple" (L); "armée" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For this block, the word "people" meaning an army in the field is "peuple" at Literal and "armée", "troupes" or "soldats" at Balanced and Readable, as in Samuel. Balanced uses an impersonal "il n'était resté" so that the subject is not taken for the LORD (m2).

decisions.choice: watu (Literal); askari (Balanced); jeshi (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Samuel, "the people" as a fighting force is "watu" at Literal and "askari" or "jeshi" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: mavumbi ya kupurwa
decisions.reason: The verb is used of threshing grain (meaning decision m4); "kupura" is the Swahili word for threshing, so Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: [quân] dân (L); quân lính (B); quân đội (R)
decisions.reason: As in Samuel, "the people" meaning an army is the ordinary word at Literal, with "quân" supplied, and troops or army at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "백성" (L); "군대" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word for "people" here means the army, the settled choice from Samuel: Literal keeps the ordinary word, Balanced and Readable say "군대".

decisions.choice: "남은 군대는 ... 뿐이었다" with no named subject
decisions.reason: As the English passive does, Balanced and Readable avoid an unnamed "he" that could be taken for God (meaning decision m2).

source.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוֹאָחָ֛ז וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וּגְבוּרָת֑וֹ הֲלוֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Jehoahaz and all that he did and his might, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of [the] kings of Israel?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, all that he did and his might, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else about Jehoahaz, all he did and his great deeds, is written in the history of the kings of Israel.

es.L: Y los demás hechos de Joacaz, y todo lo que hizo, y su poderío, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Joacaz, todo lo que hizo y su poderío, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Joacaz, y sus hazañas, está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Joachaz, et tout ce qu’il fit, et sa vaillance, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Joachaz, tout ce qu’il fit et sa vaillance, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout le reste de ce qu’a fait Joachaz, et ses exploits, a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Yehoahazi, na yote aliyoyafanya, na nguvu zake, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Yehoahazi, yote aliyoyafanya na nguvu zake, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote kuhusu Yehoahazi, yote aliyoyafanya na matendo yake makuu, yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Giô-a-cha, mọi điều ông đã làm và sức mạnh của ông, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của Giô-a-cha, mọi điều ông đã làm và sức mạnh của ông, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác về Giô-a-cha, những gì ông đã làm và những chiến công của ông, đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 여호아하스의 나머지 일들과 그가 한 모든 것과 그의 용맹은 이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 여호아하스의 나머지 행적과 그가 한 모든 일과 그의 용맹은 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 여호아하스에 관한 나머지 이야기, 곧 그가 한 모든 일과 그의 용감한 업적은 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel: a royal record now lost
decisions.reason: Kings names the records it drew on (1 Kings 14:19; 2 Kings 1:18). This one was a history of the kings of Israel; it has not survived, and the writer sends readers to it for what he leaves out.

decisions.choice: are they not written ...?: a question that means "they are written"
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer yes. It is the standard closing formula for a reign.

decisions.choice: his might: his strength and deeds in war
decisions.reason: The formula speaks of a king's might even where, as here, his army had been reduced to almost nothing (verse 7). It is the fixed wording for every reign.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel (Literal); the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel (Balanced); the history of the kings of Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: The source formula has one wording at each level throughout Kings. Balanced and Readable turn the question into a statement (m2).

decisions.choice: "el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel" (L); "el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel" (B); "la historia de los reyes de Israel" (R)
alternatives: el libro de las Crónicas de los reyes de Israel
decisions.reason: The source formula keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets it, and avoids "Crónicas", the Spanish title of the book of Chronicles. Balanced and Readable turn the question into a statement (m2).

decisions.choice: "le livre des Annales des rois d'Israël" at every level; a question at Literal, a statement at Balanced and Readable
alternatives: "le livre des Chroniques des rois d'Israël"
decisions.reason: The source formula keeps one wording through Kings, as the terms note sets; "Annales" keeps the lost royal record apart from the title of the book of Chronicles ("les Chroniques").

decisions.choice: kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli (Literal); Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli (Balanced); historia ya wafalme wa Israeli (Readable)
decisions.reason: The source formula has one wording per level through Kings, as the terms note sets it. "Mambo ya Nyakati" is avoided because it is the Swahili title of Chronicles, a different book.

decisions.choice: sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên ... sao? (L); Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên (B); sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên (R)
decisions.reason: The source formula has one wording at each level through Kings. Literal keeps the question; Balanced and Readable make it a statement, as the terms note sets. "Biên Niên Sử" is avoided because it is the title of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일을 적은 책" (L); "이스라엘 왕 실록" (B); "이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책" (R)
decisions.reason: The source formula of the terms note. The name must not be confused with the Korean title of Chronicles (역대기), so Balanced uses "실록"; the question stays at Literal and is a statement at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהֽוֹאָחָז֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֖הוּ בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Jehoahaz with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria, and reigned Joash his son in his place.

en.L: And Jehoahaz lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria, and Joash his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Jehoahaz rested with his ancestors, and they buried him in Samaria. His son Joash became king in his place.
en.R: Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria. His son Joash became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Joacaz con sus padres, y lo sepultaron en Samaria; y reinó en su lugar Joás su hijo.
es.B: Joacaz descansó con sus antepasados, y lo sepultaron en Samaria. Su hijo Joás reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Joacaz murió y fue sepultado en Samaria. Su hijo Joás lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Joachaz se coucha avec ses pères, et on l’enterra à Samarie ; et Joas son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Joachaz reposa avec ses ancêtres, et on l’enterra à Samarie. Son fils Joas régna à sa place.
fr.R: Joachaz est mort et a été enterré à Samarie. Son fils Joas est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Naye Yehoahazi akalala pamoja na baba zake, wakamzika huko Samaria, na Yoashi mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Yehoahazi alipumzika pamoja na babu zake, wakamzika huko Samaria. Na mwanawe Yoashi akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Yehoahazi alikufa, akazikwa huko Samaria. Na mwanawe Yoashi akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Giô-a-cha nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và người ta chôn ông tại Sa-ma-ri; Giô-ách con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Giô-a-cha an giấc cùng tổ tiên và được chôn tại Sa-ma-ri. Giô-ách con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Giô-a-cha qua đời và được chôn tại Sa-ma-ri. Giô-ách con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 여호아하스가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 사람들이 그를 사마리아에 묻었다. 그리고 그의 아들 요아스가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 여호아하스는 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 사람들이 그를 사마리아에 묻었다. 그의 아들 요아스가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 여호아하스는 죽었고 사마리아에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 요아스가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: This is the formula Kings uses for a king's death (1 Kings 2:10; 2 Kings 10:35).

decisions.choice: Joash: the same king as Jehoash in verse 10
decisions.reason: Joash is a short form of the name Jehoash, and the chapter uses both for this king of Israel (verses 10, 25). He is a different man from Joash king of Judah (verse 1), who reigned at the same time.

decisions.choice: the death formula; Joash
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings. The king's name follows the form each verse uses, Joash or Jehoash, at every level.

decisions.choice: "durmió con sus padres" (L); "descansó con sus antepasados" (B); "murió" (R); "Su hijo Joás lo sucedió como rey" (R)
decisions.reason: The death and successor formulas keep one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets them.

decisions.choice: the death formula: "se coucha avec ses pères" (L), "reposa avec ses ancêtres" (B), "est mort" (R); the successor: "régna à sa place", R "est devenu roi à sa place"
decisions.reason: The fixed French wording through Kings, as the terms note sets. The king of Israel is Joas here and Yehoash in verse 10, as the Hebrew has it.

decisions.choice: alilala pamoja na baba zake (Literal); alipumzika pamoja na babu zake (Balanced); alikufa (Readable); Yoashi / Yehoashi
decisions.reason: The death formula and the successor have one wording per level through Kings, as the terms note sets it. The king's name follows each verse: Yoashi here, Yehoashi in verse 10.

decisions.choice: nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình (L); an giấc cùng tổ tiên (B); qua đời (R); lên kế vị
decisions.reason: The death and successor formulas keep the terms note wording at each level through Kings. The king is Giô-ách here and Giê-hô-ách in verse 10, as each verse spells him.

decisions.choice: The death formula "조상들과 함께 누웠다" (L), "조상들과 함께 잠들었다" (B), "죽었다" (R); the successor "그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다" (L), "뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The fixed wording of the terms note. The king's name keeps the form each verse uses, 요아스 here and 여호아스 in verse 10.

source.text: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָשֶׁ֨בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְיוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יְהוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן־יְהוֹאָחָ֤ז עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In year thirty and seven year of Joash king of Judah reigned Jehoash son of Jehoahaz over Israel in Samaria six-teen year[s].

en.L: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz reigned over Israel in Samaria sixteen years.
en.B: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.
en.R: Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king over Israel in the thirty-seventh year that Joash was king of Judah. He ruled from Samaria for sixteen years.

es.L: En el año treinta y siete de Joás, rey de Judá, reinó Joás hijo de Joacaz sobre Israel en Samaria dieciséis años.
es.B: En el año treinta y siete de Joás, rey de Judá, Joás hijo de Joacaz comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Samaria, y reinó dieciséis años.
es.R: Joás hijo de Joacaz comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en el año treinta y siete del reinado de Joás en Judá. Gobernó desde Samaria durante dieciséis años.

fr.L: En la trente-septième année de Joas, roi de Juda, Yehoash fils de Joachaz régna sur Israël à Samarie seize ans.
fr.B: La trente-septième année du règne de Joas, roi de Juda, Yehoash, fils de Joachaz, devint roi d’Israël à Samarie ; il régna seize ans.
fr.R: Yehoash fils de Joachaz est devenu roi d’Israël la trente-septième année du règne de Joas, roi de Juda. Il a régné à Samarie pendant seize ans.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda, Yehoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi alitawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria miaka kumi na sita.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda, Yehoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria, akatawala miaka kumi na sita.
sw.R: Yehoashi mwana wa Yehoahazi alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba wa utawala wa Yoashi mfalme wa Yuda. Alitawala akiwa Samaria kwa miaka kumi na sita.

vi.L: Năm thứ ba mươi bảy đời Giô-ách vua Giu-đa, Giê-hô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha trị vì trên Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri mười sáu năm.
vi.B: Năm thứ ba mươi bảy đời Giô-ách vua Giu-đa, Giê-hô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri và trị vì mười sáu năm.
vi.R: Giê-hô-ách con trai Giô-a-cha lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên vào năm thứ ba mươi bảy đời Giô-ách làm vua Giu-đa. Ông cai trị tại Sa-ma-ri mười sáu năm.

ko.L: 유다 왕 요아스의 제삼십칠년에 여호아하스의 아들 여호아스가 사마리아에서 이스라엘을 십육 년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 유다 왕 요아스가 다스린 지 삼십칠 년째 되는 해에 여호아하스의 아들 여호아스가 사마리아에서 이스라엘의 왕이 되어 십육 년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.R: 유다 왕 요아스가 다스린 지 삼십칠 년째 되는 해에 여호아하스의 아들 여호아스가 이스라엘의 왕이 되었다. 그는 사마리아에서 십육 년 동안 다스렸다.

decisions.choice: the thirty-seventh year: the dates do not add up simply
alternatives: a shared reign of father and son
different ways of counting reign years in Judah and Israel
decisions.reason: Jehoahaz began in Joash's twenty-third year and reigned seventeen years (verse 1), which would bring his son's accession to about Joash's thirty-ninth year, not his thirty-seventh. The difference may come from a time when father and son reigned together, or from Judah and Israel counting a king's first part-year in different ways. The numbers are kept as the text gives them.

decisions.choice: Jehoash: the full form of the name Joash
decisions.reason: See verse 9.

decisions.choice: and he reigned
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

source.text: וַיַּֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִכָּל־חַטֹּ֞אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן־נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר־הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֥הּ הָלָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh; not he turned aside from all [the] sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat which he made sin Israel; in it he walked.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; he did not turn aside from all the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he made Israel sin; in it he walked.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, by which he led Israel to sin, but walked in them.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil. He did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, the sins by which Jeroboam led Israel into sin. He kept on living in them.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; no se apartó de ninguno de los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, con que hizo pecar a Israel; en ello anduvo.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. No se apartó de ninguno de los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, que este hizo cometer a Israel, sino que anduvo en ellos.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba. No se apartó de ninguno de los pecados de Jeroboam hijo de Nabat, los pecados con que Jeroboam hizo pecar a Israel. Siguió viviendo en ellos.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; il ne se détourna d’aucun des péchés de Jéroboam fils de Nebath, qu’il avait fait commettre à Israël ; il y marcha.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il ne se détourna d’aucun des péchés de Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, qu’il avait fait commettre à Israël, mais il y marcha.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais. Il ne s’est détourné d’aucun des péchés de Jéroboam fils de Nebath, ces péchés que Jéroboam avait fait commettre à Israël. Il a continué à vivre dans ces péchés.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; hakugeuka kuziacha dhambi zote za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, alizowafanya Israeli kutenda; aliendelea kwenda ndani yake.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hakuiacha hata moja ya dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, alizowafanya Israeli kutenda, bali aliendelea kuenenda ndani yake.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya. Hakuiacha hata moja ya dhambi za Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati, dhambi ambazo Yeroboamu aliwaongoza Israeli kuzitenda. Aliendelea kuishi katika dhambi hizo.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; ông không lìa bỏ mọi tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, là tội mà ông ấy đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm; ông đi trong tội ấy.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ông không từ bỏ tội nào trong các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, là tội mà ông ấy đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm, nhưng cứ đi trong các tội ấy.
vi.R: Ông làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác. Ông không từ bỏ tội nào trong các tội của Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát, là những tội mà Giê-rô-bô-am đã khiến Y-sơ-ra-ên phạm. Ông cứ sống trong các tội đó.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다. 그는 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 모든 죄에서 떠나지 않았다. 그가 그것 안에서 걸었다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다. 그는 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄를 하나도 버리지 않고 그 죄 가운데서 살았다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다. 그는 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 이스라엘에게 짓게 한 죄를 하나도 버리지 않았다. 그는 계속 그 죄 가운데서 살았다.

decisions.choice: the same verdict as for his father
decisions.reason: Jehoash kept Jeroboam's calf worship, as Jehoahaz did (verse 2). Even so, Yahweh gives him victories over Aram (verses 17-19, 25).

decisions.choice: in it he walked: Jehoash kept living in that sin
decisions.reason: Here the subject is the king himself. As in verse 2, the singular "it" gathers the sins as one.

decisions.choice: the verdict and the sin of Jeroboam in their fixed wording
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

source.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י יוֹאָשׁ֙ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וּגְב֣וּרָת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִלְחַ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲמַצְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה הֲלֽוֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Joash and all that he did and his might with which he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of [the] kings of Israel?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Joash, all that he did and the might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else Joash did, including his great deeds and his war against Amaziah king of Judah, is written in the history of the kings of Israel.

es.L: Y los demás hechos de Joás, y todo lo que hizo, y su poderío con que peleó contra Amasías, rey de Judá, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Joás, todo lo que hizo y el poderío con que peleó contra Amasías, rey de Judá, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Joás, con sus hazañas y su guerra contra Amasías, rey de Judá, está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Joas, et tout ce qu’il fit, et sa vaillance avec laquelle il combattit contre Amatsia, roi de Juda, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Joas, tout ce qu’il fit et la vaillance avec laquelle il combattit contre Amatsia, roi de Juda, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout le reste de ce qu’a fait Joas, ses exploits et sa guerre contre Amatsia, roi de Juda, a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Yoashi, na yote aliyoyafanya, na nguvu zake alizopigana nazo na Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Yoashi, yote aliyoyafanya na nguvu alizopigana nazo dhidi ya Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Yoashi, pamoja na matendo yake makuu na vita vyake dhidi ya Amazia mfalme wa Yuda, yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Giô-ách, mọi điều ông đã làm và sức mạnh mà ông đã dùng để giao chiến với A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của Giô-ách, mọi điều ông đã làm và sức mạnh ông đã dùng để đánh A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Giô-ách đã làm, kể cả những chiến công của ông và cuộc chiến của ông với A-ma-xia vua Giu-đa, đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 요아스의 나머지 일들과 그가 한 모든 것과 그가 유다 왕 아마샤와 싸운 그의 용맹은 이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 요아스의 나머지 행적과 그가 한 모든 일과 그가 유다 왕 아마샤와 맞서 싸운 용맹은 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 요아스가 한 나머지 일, 곧 그의 용감한 업적과 그가 유다 왕 아마샤와 벌인 전쟁은 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

decisions.choice: he fought with Amaziah king of Judah: the war told in 14:8-14
decisions.reason: Amaziah, the son of Joash of Judah, challenged Jehoash and was defeated at Beth-shemesh. The same closing formula is given again after that story (14:15-16).

decisions.choice: fought with: fought against
decisions.reason: With this verb, "with" names the enemy.

decisions.choice: the source formula
decisions.reason: As in verse 8.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹאָשׁ֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וְיָרָבְעָ֖ם יָשַׁ֣ב עַל־כִּסְא֑וֹ וַיִּקָּבֵ֤ר יוֹאָשׁ֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Joash with his fathers, and Jeroboam sat on his throne; and was buried Joash in Samaria with [the] kings of Israel.

en.L: And Joash lay down with his fathers, and Jeroboam sat on his throne. And Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
en.B: Joash rested with his ancestors, and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
en.R: Joash died, and his son Jeroboam took his place as king. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

es.L: Y durmió Joás con sus padres, y Jeroboam se sentó en su trono. Y Joás fue sepultado en Samaria con los reyes de Israel.
es.B: Joás descansó con sus antepasados, y Jeroboam se sentó en su trono. Joás fue sepultado en Samaria junto a los reyes de Israel.
es.R: Joás murió, y su hijo Jeroboam ocupó su lugar como rey. Joás fue sepultado en Samaria junto a los reyes de Israel.

fr.L: Et Joas se coucha avec ses pères, et Jéroboam s’assit sur son trône. Et Joas fut enterré à Samarie avec les rois d’Israël.
fr.B: Joas reposa avec ses ancêtres, et Jéroboam s’assit sur son trône. Joas fut enterré à Samarie avec les rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Joas est mort, et son fils Jéroboam est devenu roi à sa place. Joas a été enterré à Samarie avec les rois d’Israël.

sw.L: Naye Yoashi akalala pamoja na baba zake, na Yeroboamu akaketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi. Naye Yoashi akazikwa huko Samaria pamoja na wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.B: Yoashi alipumzika pamoja na babu zake, na Yeroboamu akaketi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi. Yoashi akazikwa huko Samaria pamoja na wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Yoashi alikufa, na mwanawe Yeroboamu akashika nafasi yake kuwa mfalme. Yoashi alizikwa huko Samaria pamoja na wafalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Giô-ách nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và Giê-rô-bô-am ngồi trên ngai của ông. Giô-ách được chôn tại Sa-ma-ri với các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Giô-ách an giấc cùng tổ tiên, và Giê-rô-bô-am ngồi trên ngai của ông. Giô-ách được chôn tại Sa-ma-ri với các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Giô-ách qua đời, và Giê-rô-bô-am con trai ông lên làm vua thay ông. Giô-ách được chôn tại Sa-ma-ri với các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 요아스가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 여로보암이 그의 왕좌에 앉았다. 그리고 요아스는 사마리아에 이스라엘 왕들과 함께 묻혔다.
ko.B: 요아스는 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 여로보암이 그의 왕좌에 앉았다. 요아스는 사마리아에 이스라엘 왕들과 함께 묻혔다.
ko.R: 요아스가 죽자 그의 아들 여로보암이 그의 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다. 요아스는 사마리아에 이스라엘 왕들과 함께 묻혔다.

decisions.choice: the reign is closed before the stories of Elisha's death and the wars with Aram
decisions.reason: Kings ends its account of Jehoash here, then tells events from within his reign (verses 14-25). The order groups the stories around Elisha rather than following time strictly.

decisions.choice: Jeroboam: the son of Jehoash, the second king of Israel with this name
decisions.reason: This is not Jeroboam son of Nebat but Jeroboam son of Joash, who reigned forty-one years and won back much of Israel's land (14:23-28).

decisions.choice: sat on his throne: became king after him
decisions.reason: Kings usually says "reigned in his place" (verse 9); this wording means the same.

decisions.choice: his son Jeroboam; took his place as king
decisions.reason: Readable adds "his son" from 14:23, so that this Jeroboam is not confused with Jeroboam son of Nebat, and explains "sat on his throne".

decisions.choice: "son fils Jéroboam"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, French adds "son fils" so that this Jeroboam is not taken for Jeroboam son of Nebat (m2).

decisions.choice: mwanawe Yeroboamu
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, "his son" is added so this Jeroboam is not taken for Jeroboam son of Nebat.

decisions.choice: "그의 아들 여로보암"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, so that this Jeroboam is not taken for Jeroboam son of Nebat (14:23).

source.text: וֶֽאֱלִישָׁע֙ חָלָ֣ה אֶת־חָלְי֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָמ֖וּת בּ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨רֶד אֵלָ֜יו יוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיֵּ֤בְךְּ עַל־פָּנָיו֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר אָבִ֣י׀אָבִ֔י רֶ֥כֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּפָרָשָֽׁיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And Elisha was sick [with] his sickness which he would die by it; and went down to him Joash king of Israel and wept over his face and said, My father, my father! [The] chariotry of Israel and its horsemen!

en.L: And Elisha had fallen sick with his sickness of which he would die. And Joash king of Israel went down to him and wept over his face and said, "My father, my father! The chariots of Israel and its horsemen!"
en.B: Now Elisha had fallen ill with the sickness that would bring his death. Joash king of Israel went down to see him and wept over him. He said, "My father, my father! The chariots of Israel and its horsemen!"
en.R: Elisha became sick with the illness that would end his life. Joash king of Israel went down to see him. He wept over him and cried, "My father, my father! The chariots and horsemen of Israel!"

es.L: Y Eliseo había enfermado de la enfermedad de la que iba a morir. Y descendió a él Joás, rey de Israel, y lloró sobre su rostro, y dijo: «¡Padre mío, padre mío! ¡Carros de Israel y su caballería!».
es.B: Eliseo había caído enfermo de la enfermedad que lo llevaría a la muerte. Joás, rey de Israel, bajó a verlo y lloró junto a él. Le dijo: «¡Padre mío, padre mío! ¡Carros de Israel y sus jinetes!».
es.R: Eliseo cayó enfermo de la enfermedad que acabaría con su vida. Joás, rey de Israel, bajó a visitarlo. Lloró junto a él y exclamó: «¡Padre mío, padre mío! ¡Los carros y los jinetes de Israel!».

fr.L: Et Élisée était tombé malade de la maladie dont il allait mourir. Et Joas, roi d’Israël, descendit vers lui, et pleura sur son visage, et dit : « Mon père, mon père ! Char d’Israël et ses cavaliers ! »
fr.B: Or Élisée était tombé malade de la maladie qui allait l’emporter. Joas, roi d’Israël, descendit le voir et pleura sur lui. Il dit : « Mon père, mon père ! Les chars d’Israël et ses cavaliers ! »
fr.R: Élisée est tombé malade d’une maladie dont il allait mourir. Joas, roi d’Israël, est descendu le voir. Il a pleuré près de lui et s’est écrié : « Mon père, mon père ! Les chars et les cavaliers d’Israël ! »

sw.L: Naye Elisha alikuwa ameugua ugonjwa wake ambao angekufa kwa huo. Naye Yoashi mfalme wa Israeli akashuka kwake, akalia juu ya uso wake, akasema, "Baba yangu, baba yangu! Magari ya vita ya Israeli na wapanda farasi wake!"
sw.B: Basi Elisha alikuwa ameugua ugonjwa ambao ungemletea kifo. Yoashi mfalme wa Israeli akashuka kwenda kumwona, akalia juu yake. Akasema, "Baba yangu, baba yangu! Magari ya vita ya Israeli na wapanda farasi wake!"
sw.R: Elisha aliugua ugonjwa ambao ungemwua. Yoashi mfalme wa Israeli alishuka kwenda kumwona. Akalia juu yake, akasema kwa sauti, "Baba yangu, baba yangu! Magari ya vita na wapanda farasi wa Israeli!"

vi.L: Ê-li-sê lâm bệnh, là bệnh mà ông sẽ chết vì nó. Giô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi xuống thăm ông và khóc trên mặt ông mà nói: "Cha ơi, cha ơi! Xe chiến mã của Y-sơ-ra-ên và kỵ binh của nó!"
vi.B: Bấy giờ Ê-li-sê lâm bệnh, là bệnh sẽ làm ông chết. Giô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi xuống thăm ông và cúi xuống khóc bên ông. Vua nói: "Cha ơi, cha ơi! Xe chiến mã của Y-sơ-ra-ên và kỵ binh của nó!"
vi.R: Ê-li-sê mắc bệnh nặng, và bệnh này sẽ cướp đi mạng sống ông. Giô-ách vua Y-sơ-ra-ên đi xuống thăm ông. Vua cúi xuống khóc bên ông và kêu lên: "Cha ơi, cha ơi! Xe chiến mã và kỵ binh của Y-sơ-ra-ên!"

ko.L: 그리고 엘리사가 그가 죽게 될 병에 걸려 앓고 있었다. 그리고 이스라엘 왕 요아스가 그에게 내려가서 그의 얼굴 위에 엎드려 울며 말했다. "내 아버지, 내 아버지! 이스라엘의 병거와 그 기병이여!"
ko.B: 그때 엘리사가 죽을병이 들어 앓고 있었다. 이스라엘 왕 요아스가 그를 보러 내려가서 그를 붙들고 울며 말했다. "내 아버지, 내 아버지! 이스라엘의 병거와 기병이시여!"
ko.R: 엘리사가 병이 들었는데, 그 병으로 죽게 되었다. 이스라엘 왕 요아스가 그를 보러 내려갔다. 그는 엘리사를 붙들고 울며 외쳤다. "내 아버지, 내 아버지! 이스라엘의 병거와 기병이시여!"

decisions.choice: Elisha had fallen sick: a new story set in Joash's reign
decisions.reason: The verse turns back from the close of the reign (verse 13) to an event within it. Elisha has not been seen since he sent a prophet to anoint Jehu (9:1); he had served as a prophet since the days of Ahab's sons.

decisions.choice: wept over his face: bent over the dying man and wept
decisions.reason: The king comes to the sickbed and mourns the prophet before he dies.

decisions.choice: My father, my father! The chariots of Israel and its horsemen!: Elisha's own cry when Elijah was taken
decisions.reason: Elisha said these words as Elijah went up (2:12). The prophet through whom Yahweh worked was Israel's true defense, worth more than its chariots. On the king's lips the words are the more striking because Israel now has only ten chariots and fifty horsemen (verse 7). "My father" is a title of honor; Joash of Israel used it for Elisha before (6:21).

decisions.choice: the cry worded as in 2:12
decisions.reason: The cry repeats 2:12 word for word at each level, so the reader hears the echo. The Hebrew "chariot" is singular but means chariots as a force.

decisions.choice: wept over him
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "over him" for "over his face" (m2).

decisions.choice: "¡Padre mío, padre mío! ¡Carros de Israel y su caballería!" (L); "... ¡Carros de Israel y sus jinetes!" (B)
alternatives: ¡Carro de Israel y su gente de a caballo!
decisions.reason: The king repeats Elisha's cry at Elijah's going (2:12); it is worded the same way at each level so the echo is heard. "Carros y jinetes" is the terms note's wording for chariots and horsemen.

decisions.choice: "lloró junto a él"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the king wept by the dying man, for "over his face" (m2); Literal keeps the face.

decisions.choice: the cry of 2:12 at each level: "Char d'Israël et ses cavaliers" (L), "Les chars d'Israël et ses cavaliers" (B), "Les chars et les cavaliers d'Israël" (R)
decisions.reason: The king repeats Elisha's cry over Elijah (2:12), so the French keeps the same words to let the reader hear the echo; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular "char".

decisions.choice: Magari ya vita ya Israeli na wapanda farasi wake
decisions.reason: The cry repeats Elisha's cry at 2:12. "Magari ya vita" is the plural for the singular Hebrew "chariot", which means chariots as a force, and is the settled word for chariots.

decisions.choice: Cha ơi, cha ơi (the king to Elisha)
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew says "my father", the king calls the prophet "cha", as the terms note sets for 2 Kings 6:21 and 13:14; the cry repeats Elisha's own words in 2:12.

decisions.choice: "내 아버지, 내 아버지! 이스라엘의 병거와 그 기병이여!" (L), "...병거와 기병이시여!" (B, R), worded as Elisha's cry in 2:12
decisions.reason: The same words as the Korean of 2:12 at each level let the reader hear the echo; the terms note's "내 아버지여" is given up here so the two cries match.

decisions.choice: "그를 붙들고 울며"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the king bent over the dying man without the face, as the English does; Literal keeps "얼굴 위에".

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע קַ֖ח קֶ֣שֶׁת וְחִצִּ֑ים וַיִּקַּ֥ח אֵלָ֖יו קֶ֥שֶׁת וְחִצִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to him Elisha, Take a bow and arrows; and he took to himself a bow and arrows.

en.L: And Elisha said to him, "Take a bow and arrows." And he took to himself a bow and arrows.
en.B: Elisha said to him, "Take a bow and arrows." So he took a bow and arrows.
en.R: Elisha told him, "Get a bow and some arrows." So the king got a bow and arrows.

es.L: Y Eliseo le dijo: «Toma un arco y flechas». Y tomó para sí un arco y flechas.
es.B: Eliseo le dijo: «Toma un arco y flechas». Y él tomó un arco y flechas.
es.R: Eliseo le dijo: «Busca un arco y algunas flechas». Entonces el rey trajo un arco y flechas.

fr.L: Et Élisée lui dit : « Prends un arc et des flèches. » Et il prit pour lui un arc et des flèches.
fr.B: Élisée lui dit : « Prends un arc et des flèches. » Il prit donc un arc et des flèches.
fr.R: Élisée lui a dit : « Va chercher un arc et des flèches. » Alors le roi est allé chercher un arc et des flèches.

sw.L: Naye Elisha akamwambia, "Chukua upinde na mishale." Naye akajichukulia upinde na mishale.
sw.B: Elisha akamwambia, "Chukua upinde na mishale." Basi akachukua upinde na mishale.
sw.R: Elisha akamwambia, "Lete upinde na mishale kadhaa." Basi mfalme akaleta upinde na mishale.

vi.L: Ê-li-sê nói với vua: "Hãy lấy cung và tên." Vua lấy cho mình cung và tên.
vi.B: Ê-li-sê nói với vua: "Xin vua lấy cung và tên." Vậy vua lấy cung và tên.
vi.R: Ê-li-sê bảo vua: "Xin vua lấy một cây cung và mấy mũi tên." Vậy vua lấy cung và tên.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리사가 그에게 말했다. "활과 화살들을 가지십시오." 그리고 그가 활과 화살들을 가졌다.
ko.B: 엘리사가 그에게 말했다. "활과 화살을 가져오십시오." 그래서 그가 활과 화살을 가져왔다.
ko.R: 엘리사가 왕에게 말했다. "활과 화살 몇 개를 가져오십시오." 그래서 왕은 활과 화살을 가져왔다.

decisions.choice: take a bow and arrows: the start of an acted sign
decisions.reason: Prophets often acted out a message so that the action itself carried Yahweh's word (1 Kings 11:29-31; 22:11). What the king does with the bow and arrows in verses 16-19 shows what will happen in his war with Aram.

decisions.choice: the king
decisions.reason: Readable names the king where the Hebrew says only "he".

decisions.choice: Elisha to the king: vua, with "xin" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The prophet calls the king "vua", as the terms note sets; Balanced and Readable soften the command with "xin", since he speaks to his king even while directing him.

decisions.choice: Elisha speaks to the king in the formal style (합쇼체: "가져오십시오")
